English: Climate-Smart Agriculture for Resilient Livelihoods Empowering Farmers to Adapt, Thrive, and SustainAt Sustainable Solutions Kenya (SUSOK), we promote Climate-Smart Agriculture (CSA) to help smallholder farmers build resilience to climate change while increasing food security, protecting the environment, and improving livelihoods.
